# My ANT Storage

> Edit this file, then run CreateNewStorage with it. Your folders are built from this list.
> Only the `##` headings and the `-` lists below are read; everything else is ignored.
>
> - `## Name` is a **category** (level 1). Write it as plain text; ANT adds the number.
> - `- Name` is a **subcategory** (level 2).
> - `  - Name` (indented two spaces) is a **topic** (level 3).
> - `  - PJ: Name` is a **project**; ANT gives it the next free number.
> - `  - RES` or `  - TPL` add a support folder (level 2 or 3), named after its parent (`TPL.Documents`).
> - Each category also gets `REC.<NAME>`, `RES.Resources`, `REV.<NAME>` and `SS.<NAME>` automatically.
> - Every subcategory and topic gets its `REV.<NAME>` automatically too. Don't list any of these.
> - Keep names short, with no `/` or `\`. Rename or remove anything you don't need.
